public_definitions: The goal is to review the 2005-2015 temperature monitoring trend and route the record based on whether the multi-year change warrants follow-up under the substantial trend workflow.
The charted yearly temperature readings are the basis for this routing decision.
The routing decision must be based on the magnitude of change across the review period.
